_source: docs.scrapecreators.com/openapi.json + the vendor's agent skill, read 2026-09-02; most endpoints are 1 credit; the exceptions below are what the belt and the ledger must know

_notes.post_info: /v2/tiktok/video and /v1/instagram/post cost 10 credits when media is found, 1 otherwise. Use account_posts (1 credit, whole feed with stats) when you only need numbers; post_info is for the sound id, the media url and the full detail.
_notes.tiktok_transcript: 1 credit; +10 when use_ai_as_fallback=true, which we never set. Video must be under 2 minutes.
_notes.instagram_comments: 15 credits, always, because replies are fetched separately; charged even when no replies come back.
_notes.find_social_profiles: 10 credits per live lookup; 0 when the vendor's cache answers.
_notes.profiles: /v1/tiktok/profile and /v1/instagram/profile: 0 credits when answered from the vendor's cache within the requested age, 1 live.
_notes.audience: /v1/tiktok/user/audience is 26 credits; not in the belt.
